EC mortgages 英國按揭易
EN

EC mortgages is a professional UK mortgage and protection advisory firm dedicated to providing clear, reliable and personalised advice. We specialise in residential mortgages, first-time buyers, remortgages, Buy-to-Let and property investment finance, with particular experience supporting foreign nationals clients in the UK. From understanding your individual circumstances and finding a suitable mortgage solution to managing the application through to completion, our experienced team is here to guide you every step of the way, making your mortgage journey as simple, smooth and stress-free as possible.

HK

EC mortgages 係一間專業英國按揭及保險顧問公司，致力為客戶提供清晰、可靠及個人化嘅按揭方案。我哋熟悉英國住宅按揭、首次置業、轉按、Buy-to-Let 及物業投資融資，亦特別了解香港移英及 BNO 客戶嘅需要。由了解客戶情況、比較合適嘅按揭產品，到申請及完成交易，我哋都會全程提供專業協助，務求令置業及按揭過程更簡單、更安心。請到www.EcMortgage.co.uk預約免費咨詢或查看實時銀行優惠按揭產品。

Supporting Partners · 支持夥伴
EN

WaNaHong: Your One-Stop Asian Food Supermarket. Founded in 2018, WaNaHong has established itself as the leading Oriental Food Supermarket in the United Kingdom.

With a wide range of over 5,000 Asian food products from Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, Taiwan, Thailand, Malaysia, China, and even Western ingredients, WaNaHong offers a diverse selection to cater to the diverse tastes and preferences of our customers.

We understand the importance of providing authentic and high-quality Asian ingredients to our customers. We take pride in sourcing the finest ingredients from across the continent and beyond, ensuring that you can cook up a delicious and authentic Asian meal from the comfort of your own home.

Our efficient delivery service covers the majority areas in the United Kingdom, ensuring that you can savor the flavours of Asia no matter where you reside. And we do offer free delivery on orders over £50.

HK

華南行：英國一站式亞洲食品超市。華南行成立於2018年，已在英國成為極受歡迎的亞洲超市之一。

華南行提供超過5,000種亞洲食品產品，包括來自香港、日本、韓國、台灣、泰國、馬來西亞、中國以及西方的食材，以迎合顧客多樣化的口味和喜好。

華南行知道，大家對亞洲食材需求和要求也越來越高。華南行一直致力從亞洲和其他地區精心挑選最好的食材，確保顧客可以在家中煮出美味地道的亞洲菜餚。

華南行希望給顧客一個最完美的網上購物體驗，享受最快最方便最省時的購物過程。華南行提供全英送貨服務，只要顧客購物滿£50即可享免費送貨。顧客亦可簡易地在網上隨時隨地購買心儀產品，並透過受認證的付款平台結帳，簡單、方便又安全。

EN

Together Logistics UK is a professional international logistics company providing integrated door-to-door moving, ocean freight forwarding, warehousing and distribution services. Drawing on its established service network and extensive experience, Together Logistics UK delivers reliable, professional and efficient logistics solutions to its customers. The company began its operations in Hong Kong and has gradually expanded to the United Kingdom, where it has successfully served tens of thousands of customers.

HK

同行物流是一間專業的國際物流公司，提供一站式到戶搬運、海運貨運代理、倉儲及配送服務。憑藉完善的服務體系及豐富經驗，同行物流為客戶提供可靠、專業及高效的物流方案。同行物流由香港起步，業務逐步拓展至英國，至今已成功為數以萬計的客戶提供服務。

EN

Kei Hing Restaurant: Bringing the Taste of Hong Kong to the UK. Kei Hing Restaurant has its roots in Hong Kong Sham Shui Po, serving the local community for many years. After moving to the UK, he brought the familiar flavours of Hong Kong to Birmingham, continuing the tradition of Hong Kong-style dining. Kei Hing Restaurant specialises in traditional Hong Kong dishes, giving Hong Kong people in the UK a taste of home. Located in Birmingham, it carries the memories and traditions of Hong Kong dining culture.

HK

琦興大排檔：傳承香港味道。琦興大排檔源自香港深水埗，服務香港街坊多年。及後，將香港熟悉的飲食文化帶到伯明翰，延續香港經典味道。琦興大排檔以港式菜餚為主，保留香港風味，讓在英港人重拾熟悉的家鄉味道。無論是香港人聚餐，還是朋友相聚，一份熟悉的港式味道，都能帶來家的感覺。

EN

The Story of Homeplace Kitchen — Every Bite Carries History. Homeplace Kitchen's story began with our grandfather's generation, when making traditional Chinese cured meats was already part of our family heritage. Our father carried on the family recipes and refined his craft, later establishing his own workshop in Yuen Long specialising in Hong Kong-style cured meats. Years later, the third generation revived the family tradition and continued the story after moving to the UK. Every bite carries Hong Kong's culinary heritage, family memories and the familiar warmth of gathering around the table. Also joining the market as stall A01.

HK

家香的故事始於祖父一代，製作臘味早已是家族傳統。父親承傳家傳配方，後來於元朗創立自家工場，專門製作港式臘味。多年後，第三代在香港重新拾起家傳技藝，並於移居英國後延續家香的故事。每一口臘味承載的不只是風味，更凝聚了香港的飲食文化、家族記憶，以及家人相聚時那份熟悉而溫暖的情感。同時亦於市集擺設攤位A01。

Event Programme
活動流程
EN

The eye-opening ceremony is an important ritual that symbolically brings the lion to life. Once awakened, the lion comes alive through drumming, movement and expressive gestures, portraying different emotions such as joy, anger, sadness and delight. The interaction between the lion and the audience creates a lively and joyful performance experience.

HK

點睛，是賦予獅子生命的重要儀式。點睛之後，舞獅正式「醒來」，透過鼓樂、動作及豐富神態，呈現獅子的喜、怒、哀、樂。觀眾更可感受到獅子與人之間的互動、交流與喜悅，將傳統表演化成充滿生命力的現場體驗。

Register 報名 ↗
EN

The Dragon & Lion Dance Workshop, led by the Kong Yee Lion & Dragon Team, offers participants a hands-on introduction to lion and dragon dance culture, including the eye-opening ceremony, lion expressions, dragon dance, festive traditions, and its connections with martial arts.

Lion and dragon dance is also a shared cultural tradition across East and Southeast Asia, connecting communities through culture and movement. The workshop provides a simple, safe and interactive experience for people of different ages, introducing the fitness, coordination, rhythm, concentration and teamwork involved in lion and dragon dance as an accessible cultural activity and sport.

HK

龍獅工作坊由英國港義龍獅團帶領，讓參加者親身體驗龍獅文化，包括點睛、舞獅神態、舞龍、節慶文化及龍獅與武術的淵源。

龍獅文化亦是東亞及東南亞地區共同的文化傳統之一，連結不同社群。工作坊將透過簡單、安全及互動的方式，讓不同年齡人士體驗龍獅運動，認識其中的體能、協調、節奏、專注及團隊合作，讓龍獅成為一項老少咸宜的文化活動及運動。

EN

The dragon blessing ceremony is an important ritual that symbolically brings the dragon to life. Featuring an 18-section, 30-metre-long dragon — the first of its kind in the history of the Midlands — the performance requires around 50 performers working together.

Dragon dance represents a pinnacle of festive celebration, as well as a powerful cultural symbol and visual icon. The awakened dragon will parade through the market, creating a spectacular and memorable festive experience.

HK

18節、約30米長的巨型舞龍，為中部地區歷史上首條傳統舞龍，整個演出需要超過50人共同完成。舞龍是東/東南亞節慶文化的標誌，亦是一個充滿力量與象徵意義的文化圖騰。金龍將於開光後巡遊市集，帶來壯觀的視覺效果及節慶氣氛。

Food · A01–A12
EN

Homeplace Kitchen's story began with our grandfather's generation, when making traditional Chinese cured meats was already part of our family heritage. Our father carried on the family recipes and refined his craft under the guidance of an experienced cured-meat master. He later established his own workshop in Yuen Long, specialising in Hong Kong-style cured meats.

Although the workshop eventually closed, the craft was never lost. Years later, the third generation revived the family tradition in Hong Kong and continued Homeplace Kitchen's story after moving to the UK, bringing the familiar flavours of Hong Kong to a new home.

We remain committed to traditional craftsmanship, carefully selecting quality ingredients, fresh pork and aromatic spices, while following strict food safety and hygiene standards. Every bite offers more than flavour—it carries Hong Kong's culinary heritage, family memories and the familiar warmth of gathering around the table.

HK

家香的故事始於祖父一代，製作臘味早已是家族傳統。父親承傳家傳配方，並跟隨經驗豐富的臘味師傅鑽研製作技藝，後來於元朗創立自家工場，專門製作港式臘味。

工場結束後，這門手藝雖然沉寂多年，卻始終未曾失傳。多年後，第三代在香港重新拾起家傳技藝，並於移居英國後延續家香的故事，將熟悉的香港味道帶到異地，繼續傳承。

我們堅持傳統工藝，嚴選優質原材料、新鮮豬肉及香料，並按照食品安全與衛生標準製作。每一口臘味承載的不只是風味，更凝聚了香港的飲食文化、家族記憶，以及家人相聚時那份熟悉而溫暖的情感。

Retail · B09–B16
EN

Many carers face financial strain because long-term responsibilities looking after ill or special needs (SEN) family members prevent them from holding full-time jobs. West Midland Carer Crafts provides a collaborative platform that empowers carers to create unique, handcrafted goods from home. We handle the sales and offer a transparent profit-sharing model: after deducting costs, 60% of the net profit goes directly to the carer (40% supports our operations). Our mission is to turn passion into income, fostering true financial independence.

HK

許多照顧者因長期留守家中照料患病或有特殊需要（如SEN）的家人，而難以從事全職工作。為此，West Midland Carer Crafts 建立互助平台，鼓勵照顧者在家發揮手藝，製作獨一無二的創作品。我們負責產品寄賣，並在扣除成本後，將 60% 的利潤直接分予照顧者（組織留存 40% 用於營運）。我們的目標是將手藝轉化為收入，切實提升照顧者的經濟自主能力。

華南行希望給顧客一個最完美的網上購物體驗，享受最快最方便最省時的購物過程。華南行提供全英送貨服務，只要顧客購物滿£50即可享免費送貨。顧客亦可簡易地在網上隨時隨地購買心儀產品，並透過受認證的付款平台結帳，簡單、方便又安全。
